messages:
harper: Heads up team — my birthday is next Wednesday (6/9). No pressure but wanted to flag in case anyone wants to do something small :smile:
sam: happy early!! i'm remote that day but happy to contribute to a card/gift.
ella: quick poll idea: 1) office snack station (individually boxed) 2) plant instead of cake (office-friendly) 3) virtual postcard + group video. react with :cookie:, :seedling:, :envelope_with_heart:
mike: love the plant idea honestly. low mess and long-lasting. also happy with boxed snacks if people prefer.
nina: can we do both? small plant + a couple of individually wrapped pastries. low candles, high plants pls :grin:
harper: i'm easy! plant sounds lovely and low cleanup. but if folks want a tiny snack that's fine too. no need for video unless people are into it.
events-bot: POLL created — "Harper bday plan" Options: 1) Snack station (boxed) 2) Small office plant 3) Virtual postcard + video. Voting window: 48h
sam: if plant wins i can pick it up on Tuesday morning from BloomCo SF. can anyone water it for the first week?
ella: i can handle watering for the first two weeks. happy to be plant custodian.
mike: budget note: suggest $35 cap for plant + $20 for boxed snacks if needed. i'll collect $3 each via the usual link.
harper: love y'all. if plant wins, please write something short in the card: "Happy birthday Harper! Thanks for keeping the team organized and cheerful." that's perfect.
events-bot: Poll update: 12 votes — 7 :seedling:, 3 :cookie:, 2 :envelope_with_heart:
sam: great — plant majority. i'll grab a medium 6" potted plant (low light) and bring a little planter. thanks everyone!
harper: so touched. no party necessary, this is perfect. appreciate y'all :heart:
